_comment: Redistribution terms for everything Coldframe builds on. The build script
reads this to decide what may go into a published bundle: any source with
redistribute=false contributes derived statistics only, never raw values.
This is a good-faith reading of published terms, not legal advice. Where a
source is ambiguous it is marked false, because the cost of being wrong is
asymmetric and the cost of being cautious is one build flag.

araclim.name: AraCLIM (Arabidopsis CLIMtools)
araclim.requires: Attribution and licence notice in derived artifacts; the AraCLIM portion cannot be relicensed as MIT. See NOTICE.

ensembl_plants.name: Ensembl Plants, Arabidopsis thaliana TAIR10
ensembl_plants.license: No restrictions on use or redistribution
ensembl_plants.note: Preferred over TAIR direct (terms depend on which release folder a file sits in, undocumented) and over NCBI RefSeq (chromosome naming is NC_003070.9 rather than 1-5, which our VCFs use).

1001genomes.name: 1001 Genomes, v3.1 callset
1001genomes.requires: Confirm with the consortium before redistributing genotype calls.
1001genomes.note: The published policy is a Fort Lauderdale-style pre-publication clause: no whole-genome-scale analysis published ahead of the consortium. The 2016 Cell paper discharges that in substance, and a locus slice is a vanishing fraction of a 19GB callset. But no explicit redistribution grant exists, so genotype calls stay out of published bundles until someone confirms in writing.
